build_FCNMaskHead: build an FCNMaskHead instance with configurable conv layers, upsampling method, and number of classes for instance segmentation
run_forward_FCNMaskHead: run the forward pass of FCNMaskHead on extracted mask RoI features to predict foreground masks
test_loss_and_target_FCNMaskHead: test the loss_and_target method to compute mask prediction loss against ground truth mask targets
predict_masks_FCNMaskHead: predict segmentation masks from mask predictions and bounding boxes using predict_by_feat for post-processing
review_do_paste_mask: review the _do_paste_mask function that pastes instance masks onto an image grid using grid sampling
